title: Expanding the Cyber Verification Program
body: We’re launching a new, expanded version of our Cyber Verification Program, which makes advanced cyber capabilities and reduced blocking classifiers available to qualifying security professionals.

title: Introducing Claude Haiku 5.5
body: Our fastest, cheapest, and most capable small model yet. It’s designed for high-volume, cost-sensitive work.

title: Introducing Claude Sonnet 5.5
body: A clear upgrade over Sonnet 5 that runs 30% faster and costs up to 30% less for most work.

title: Introducing Claude Opus 5.5
body: Opus 5.5 performs at the level of Claude Fable 5.1 on most work and costs 40% less to run than Opus 5.

title: The Situation Report
body: A rare strain of Ebola, with no confirmed vaccine, is spreading through the east of the Democratic Republic of Congo. World health organizations are using Claude to move as fast as possible to combat it.
